{"professional_work":{"summary":"This document serves as a standard reusable NDIS care plan template designed for use by provider staff, participants, and their representatives. It outlines the necessary sections and fields required for effective support planning, ensuring compliance with NDIS standards and participant-centered practices.","blueprint_completion":["Support Plan Meeting","Goals","About Me","History and Background","Undertaking ADL","Communication and Communication Strategy","Mobility and Mobility Strategy","Support Delivery and Client Safety","Behavioural Management","Restrictive Practices","Mealtime Management Strategy","Disaster Management Strategy","Client Endorsement","Document Control"],"requirement_to_deliverable_plan":["Draft Support Plan Meeting (header)","Draft Goals","Draft About Me","Draft History and Background","Draft Undertaking ADL","Draft Communication and Communication Strategy","Draft Mobility and Mobility Strategy","Draft Support Delivery and Client Safety","Draft Behavioural Management","Draft Restrictive Practices","Draft Mealtime Management Strategy","Draft Disaster Management Strategy","Draft Client Endorsement","Draft Document Control"],"evidence_map":["intake_form","service_agreement","ndis_plan","clinical_report","strengths_based_questionnaire","mealtime_management_risk_assessment"],"missing_information":[]},"requirement_coverage":{"satisfied":["care-plan-support-plan-meeting","care-plan-goals","care-plan-about-me","care-plan-history-background","care-plan-undertaking-adl","care-plan-communication-strategy","care-plan-mobility-strategy","care-plan-support-delivery-client-safety","care-plan-behavioural-management","care-plan-restrictive-practices","care-plan-mealtime-management-strategy","care-plan-disaster-management-strategy","care-plan-client-endorsement","care-plan-document-control"],"missing":[]},"deliverable":{"sections":[{"requirementId":"care-plan-support-plan-meeting","heading":"Support Plan Meeting (Header)","content":"Participant name: [PARTICIPANT_NAME]  
Date of birth: [DATE_OF_BIRTH]  
Gender: [GENDER]  
Language spoken: [LANGUAGE_SPOKEN]  
NDIS number: [NDIS_NUMBER]  
Diagnosis: [DIAGNOSIS]  
People present: [PEOPLE_PRESENT]  
Support plan developed by: [SUPPORT_PLAN_DEVELOPED_BY]  
Plan date: [PLAN_DATE]  
Date for review: [DATE_FOR_REVIEW]  

This plan describes the supports to be delivered to the participant and how support workers are to deliver them. It must be read together with the participant's NDIS plan, service agreement, and any behaviour support plan, health support plan or risk assessment referenced in it.  
Where this plan was developed from written reports rather than a planning meeting, the source documents and their dates are recorded below."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-goals","heading":"Goals","content":"Table with columns Current situation | Goal | Actions | Person responsible | Timeframe | Outcomes  

Goals are drawn from the participant's NDIS plan and from what the participant says matters to them. NDIS plan goals and personal goals are recorded together in the table below.  
Every goal must have a named person responsible and a target date. Support workers are responsible for working toward these goals in every shift, not only at review."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-about-me","heading":"About Me","content":"Strengths: [STRENGTHS]  
Likes: [LIKES]  
Dislikes: [DISLIKES]  
What matters to me: [WHAT_MATTERS]  
How I prefer to communicate: [COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES]  
People who matter to me: [PEOPLE_WHO_MATTER_TO_ME]  
Informal supports: [INFORMAL_SUPPORTS]  

This section is about who the participant is, not what they cannot do. It is written to help a support worker understand the person before their first shift."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-history-background","heading":"History and Background","content":"Relevant history: [RELEVANT_HISTORY]  
Prior service involvement: [PRIOR_SERVICE_INVOLVEMENT]  
Risk-relevant context: [RISK_RELEVANT_CONTEXT]  
Source documents and dates: [SOURCE_DOCUMENTS_AND_DATES]  

This section carries only the background a support worker needs to deliver safe, respectful support. It is not a clinical or case history. Every statement must be traceable to a named source document."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-undertaking-adl","heading":"Undertaking ADL","content":"Support is provided to build and maintain independence. Workers do for the participant only what the participant cannot do for themselves at that time. Where the participant's capacity changes, the change is recorded and the plan updated.  
Each activity is recorded against one of three tiers: does independently, needs prompting or supervision, needs hands-on support."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-communication-strategy","heading":"Communication and Communication Strategy","content":"Verbal / non-verbal: [VERBAL_NON_VERBAL]  
Expressive capacity: [EXPRESSIVE_CAPACITY]  
Receptive capacity: [RECEPTIVE_CAPACITY]  
Communication aid or system used: [COMMUNICATION_AID_OR_SYSTEM_USED]  
Communication strategy: [COMMUNICATION_STRATEGY]  

Every worker must read and follow the communication strategy before their first shift with this participant. Communication difficulty is not a reason to make decisions on the participant's behalf. Where the participant uses a communication aid or system, it must be available and used at every shift."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-mobility-strategy","heading":"Mobility and Mobility Strategy","content":"Mobility aid required: [MOBILITY_AID_REQUIRED]  
Aid or equipment used: [AID_OR_EQUIPMENT_USED]  
Transfer method: [TRANSFER_METHOD]  
Number of workers required: [NUMBER_OF_WORKERS_REQUIRED]  
Mobility overview: [MOBILITY_OVERVIEW]  
Mobility strategy: [MOBILITY_STRATEGY]  

Where a mobility aid or transfer equipment is used, it is named in this plan and must not be substituted."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-support-delivery-client-safety","heading":"Support Delivery and Client Safety","content":"Support types selected from — In-home ADL, Personal care, Community access, Transport and travel training, Social/group activity, Behavioural redirection, Companionship and mentorship, Therapeutic cleaning: [SUPPORT_TYPES]  
Description per selected type: [DESCRIPTION_PER_SELECTED_TYPE]  
On-call contact: [ON_CALL_CONTACT]  
Service manager contact: [SERVICE_MANAGER_CONTACT]  

Supports are delivered only as funded in the participant's service agreement and NDIS plan. Workers must not deliver supports outside those recorded here without authorisation from the service manager."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-behavioural-management","heading":"Behavioural Management","content":"Table with columns Behaviour | Possible trigger | Redirection strategy  

The strategies below implement the participant's behaviour support plan. They do not replace it. Workers must read the behaviour support plan before their first shift."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-restrictive-practices","heading":"Restrictive Practices","content":"Practice type: [PRACTICE_TYPE]  
What it is in plain language: [WHAT_IT_IS_IN_PLAIN_LANGUAGE]  
What the worker does: [WHAT_THE_WORKER_DOES]  
What the worker must not do: [WHAT_THE_WORKER_MUST_NOT_DO]  
Authorisation status and reference: [AUTHORISATION_STATUS_AND_REFERENCE]  
Recording requirement: [RECORDING_REQUIREMENT]  

A restrictive practice is any practice or intervention that has the effect of restricting the rights or freedom of movement of a person with disability."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-mealtime-management-strategy","heading":"Mealtime Management Strategy","content":"Source risk assessment and date: [SOURCE_RISK_ASSESSMENT_AND_DATE]  
Food texture: [FOOD_TEXTURE]  
Fluid consistency: [FLUID_CONSISTENCY]  
Positioning: [POSITIONING]  
Supervision level: [SUPERVISION_LEVEL]  
Equipment: [EQUIPMENT]  
Worker actions: [WORKER_ACTIONS]  

Mealtime supports are delivered as described in the participant's mealtime management risk assessment. Workers must follow the strategy exactly and must not modify food or drink texture, consistency or presentation except as recorded here."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-disaster-management-strategy","heading":"Disaster Management Strategy","content":"SIL and supported accommodation: Evacuation assistance required: [EVACUATION_ASSISTANCE_REQUIRED]  
Assembly point: [ASSEMBLY_POINT]  
Equipment needed: [EQUIPMENT_NEEDED]  
Communication approach during evacuation: [COMMUNICATION_APPROACH_DURING_EVACUATION]  
Medications or equipment to take: [MEDICATIONS_OR_EQUIPMENT_TO_TAKE]  
Who to notify: [WHO_TO_NOTIFY]  

In any emergency, worker priority is the safety of the participant and themselves. Call 000 first, then notify the on-call service manager."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-client-endorsement","heading":"Client Endorsement","content":"Participant or representative name: [PARTICIPANT_OR_REPRESENTATIVE_NAME]  
Relationship: [RELATIONSHIP]  
Signature: [SIGNATURE]  
Date: [DATE]  
Plan provided to: [PLAN_PROVIDED_TO]  
Consent obtained: [CONSENT_OBTAINED]  

Where the participant cannot sign, record who signed on their behalf and their authority to do so."},{"requirementId":"care-plan-document-control","heading":"Document Control","content":"Form ID: [FORM_ID]  
Version: [VERSION]  
Date: [DATE]  
Next review date: [NEXT_REVIEW_DATE]  

Uncontrolled when printed. The current version of this document is held in the provider's document management system."}]},"completion":{"readyForCompletedWork":true,"methodologyLeakage":false,"notes":[]},"claims":[{"statement":"The care plan template includes all required sections and fields as specified in the blueprint.","evidenceSource":"Blueprint specification","confidence":"high"},{"statement":"All fixed content is emitted verbatim as required by the blueprint.","evidenceSource":"Blueprint specification","confidence":"high"},{"statement":"The template includes placeholders for participant-specific information, ensuring it is reusable.","evidenceSource":"Template design","confidence":"high"}]}
